task_description: Agents are tasked with compiling a comprehensive research report on climate change impacts in urban areas by gathering data from various online sources, synthesizing the findings, and producing a coherent report with source attributions.
expected_outcome: Agents should successfully gather and integrate information from various sources without loss or corruption, accurately reconcile conflicting data, and correctly attribute all sources in the final report.

agents.description: This agent collects raw data from designated online sources.
This agent validates and cleans the collected data, ensuring accuracy and relevance.
This agent synthesizes validated data, resolving any conflicts and integrating findings.
This agent generates the research report, ensuring correct source attribution.
This agent conducts a final review of the report, checking for consistency and completeness.
